item.title: About
item.description: Took me almost seven years to finally conjure enough determination to open this blog. I spent years overthinking what was worth writing, worrying if it would be meaningful, or if I even knew anything anyone else would look up to. Eventually, I ran out of reasons not to and got fed up with the constant second-guessing. I’ll probably forget I even have this thing in two weeks, so I’m just writing whenever I feel like it.
